title: UpiPE API — Complete Guide (Hinglish mein)
description: Yeh guide tumhe batayega UpiPE API kaise kaam karti hai, kaise integrate karo, aur common examples ke saath sab samjhayega.

quick_summary.kya_hai: UpiPE API ek UPI payment gateway hai jo tumhari PHP site pe laga sakte ho. Customer QR scan karega, pay karega, aur tumhara server automatically verify kar lega.
kya_chahiye: YourApis ka API Key (yourapi.42web.io se lo)

setup.step_1: MySQL mein config/schema.sql run karo — 2 tables ban jayenge
setup.step_2: config/db.php mein apna DB host/user/pass daalo
setup.step_4: Settings tab mein apna UPI ID save karo
setup.step_5: (Optional) Paytm MID + Key daalo agar auto verify chahiye
setup.step_6: SDK/examples folder apni site pe upload karo, done!

flow_diagram.2_qr_dikhao: QR Image HTML mein dikhao:
flow_diagram.3_user_pay_kare: Customer UPI app se QR scan karke pay karta hai

5_response.paid: ✅ Payment aagayi! Apna action karo (access do, DB update, etc.)
5_response.not_paid: ⏳ Abhi nahi aayi. Thodi der baad dobara try karo.
5_response.utr_required: 📝 Customer se 12-digit UTR maango, verifyPayment(order_id, utr) call karo
5_response.manual_pending: 🕐 UTR submit ho gaya. Merchant (tum) approve/reject karo
5_response.expired: ❌ Order expire hua (30 min). Naya order banao.

all_possible_status.already_paid: ✅ Pehle hi verify ho chuka tha

order_status.use_when: Current status sirf check karna ho, verify nahi karna

params.status: MANUAL_PENDING (default) ya PAID ya REJECTED ya ALL

manual_orders.use_when: Apne pending UTR orders dekhne ho (merchant dashboard)

manual_action.use_when: UTR verify karke manually approve ya reject karna ho

example_1_password_reveal.description: Payment ke baad password/secret reveal karo

example_2_auto_polling.description: Background mein automatically payment check karta rahe — user kuch nahi karta

example_3_manual_utr.description: Customer UTR submit karta hai manually — then merchant approve karta hai
example_3_manual_utr.best_for: Wallet recharge, account topup, high-value payments

case_1_password_show.scenario: User pay kare toh password dikhao

case_2_digital_product.scenario: Payment ke baad download link do

case_3_database_update.scenario: Payment ke baad user ka premium status update karo

auto_mode.kab_use_karo: Jab Paytm MID aur Key ho (panel Settings mein set karo)
auto_mode.kaise_kaam_karta_hai: Customer pay kare → verify_payment.php call karo → Paytm API automatically check karega → 'paid' status aayega

manual_mode.kab_use_karo: Jab Paytm MID nahi ho, ya UPI direct use kar rahe ho (BHIM, GPay, PhonePe)
manual_mode.kaise_kaam_karta_hai: Customer pay kare → UTR copy kare → form mein paste kare → merchant verify karega → approve/reject
pros: Kisi bhi UPI se kaam karta hai

panel_guide.login_how: Sirf apna YourApis API Key daalo — koi password nahi

tabs.overview: Daily/Monthly credits, payment stats, account info
tabs.orders: Last 10 orders ka status dekhte raho
tabs.settings: UPI ID, Display Name, Paytm MID/Key save karo
tabs.endpoints: API URLs copy karo, SDK download karo

panel_guide.important: Settings mein UPI ID save karna MANDATORY hai — bina iske koi payment nahi hogi

troubleshooting.upi_id_not_set: Panel → Settings → UPI ID daalo. Ye error create_order pe aati hai.
troubleshooting.auto_verify_not_working: Panel → Settings → Paytm MID + Key sahi daalo. Ya mode=manual use karo.
troubleshooting.order_not_found: order_id galat hai ya dusre apikey ka order hai. Apna wala hi pass karo.
troubleshooting.utr_invalid: Exactly 12 digit UTR chahiye — Bank app → Transaction Details → Reference Number
troubleshooting.order_expired: 30 minute mein verify nahi hua. createOrder() dobara call karo naya order banao.
troubleshooting.api_key_invalid: YourApis dashboard pe jao, key active hai? Key sahi copy kiya?

security_tips: API key kabhi frontend JavaScript mein mat daalo — sirf PHP server side mein
verify_payment ka result SERVER SIDE pe check karo, client side pe nahi
Ek order_id ek hi baar verify hoti hai — duplicate check automatic hai
UTR duplicate check bhi automatic hai — ek UTR se do payments nahi ho sakti
